description_en: Queries information about servers on which a baseline check is performed. The information includes the IDs of the servers, the statistics of a risk item, and the status of the risk item
description_zh: 查询执行了基线检查的服务器的信息，包含服务器的ID、检测到的风险项统计数据和风险项状态等信息
name: DescribeWarningMachines

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The name of the server on which the baseline check is performed
parameters.help_zh: 执行基线检查的服务器的名称
parameters.name: machine_name

parameters.help_en: The UUID of the server on which the baseline check is performed. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 执行基线检查的服务器ID。多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: uuids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the risk item.

You can call the [DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~DescribeCheckWarningSummary~~) operation to query the IDs of risk items
parameters.help_zh:
风险项的ID。

您可调用[DescribeCheckWarningSummary](~~DescribeCheckWarningSummary~~)接口获取风险项ID
parameters.name: risk_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the baseline check policy
parameters.name: strategy_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10, which indicates that 10 entries of server information are displayed on each page. A maximum of 100 entries can be returned per page
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的服务器信息的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条服务器信息，最大不超过100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the container cluster.

You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to query the IDs of container clusters
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的容器集群的ID。
您可以调用[DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the field that is used to search for the container. Valid values:

CONTAINER_ID: the ID of the container
IMAGE: the name of the image
NAMESPACE: the namespace
NODE_NAME: the name of the node
POD_IP: the IP address of the pod
HOST_IP: the IP address of the host
INSTANCE_ID: the ID of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
容器检索字段。取值：

CONTAINER_ID：容器ID。
IMAGE：镜像名称。
NAMESPACE：命名空间。
NODE_NAME：节点名称。
POD_IP：pod地址。
HOST_IP：主机地址。
INSTANCE_ID：实例ID
parameters.name: container_field_name

parameters.help_en: The value of the field that is used to search for the container
parameters.name: container_field_value

parameters.help_en:
The type of the query condition. Valid values:

containerId: the ID of the container
uuid: the UUID of the asset
parameters.help_zh:
查询类型。取值：

containerId：容器ID
uuid：资产ID
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether risks were detected. Valid values:

1: yes
0: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否存在风险。取值：

1：有风险。
0：无风险
parameters.name: have_risk

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/130972.html operation to query the IDs of asset groups
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的资产分组ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/130972.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: group_id

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page
Count.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页面显示的服务器信息的数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned page
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page. Default value: 10
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的服务器信息的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条服务器信息

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的服务器信息的总数量

items.description_en: The information about the servers on which alerts are generated
items.description_zh: 产生告警的服务器的信息

AssetType.description_en:
The type of cloud product assets.
You can call [ListCloudAssetInstances](~~ListCloudAssetInstances~~) to query the types of cloud product assets
AssetType.description_zh:
云产品资产的类型。

您可以调用[ListCloudAssetInstances](~~ListCloudAssetInstances~~)查询云产品资产的类型

AuthVersion.description_en:
The edition of Security Center that is authorized to protect the asset. Valid values:

1: Basic edition
6: Anti-virus edition
5: Advanced edition
3: Enterprise edition
7: Ultimate edition
10: Value-added Plan edition
AuthVersion.description_zh:
资产的授权版本。取值：

1：免费版
6：防病毒版
5：高级版
3：企业版
7：旗舰版
10：仅采购增值服务版

Bind.description_en:
Indicates whether Security Center is authorized to protect the asset. Valid values:

true
false
Bind.description_zh:
资产是否已绑定授权。取值：

true：已绑定授权
false：未绑定授权

HighWarningCount.description_en: The number of high-risk items on the server
HighWarningCount.description_zh: 服务器上存在的高危检查项的数量

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address of the server

IntranetIp.description_en: The private IP address of the server

LowWarningCount.description_en: The number of low-risk items on the server
LowWarningCount.description_zh: 服务器上存在的低危检查项的数量

MediumWarningCount.description_en: The number of medium-risk items on the server
MediumWarningCount.description_zh: 服务器上存在的中危检查项的数量

Online.description_en:
Indicates whether the agent is online. Valid values:

true
false
Online.description_zh:
客户端是否在线。取值：
true：在线
false：离线

PassCount.description_en: The number of the check items that passed the baseline check on the server
PassCount.description_zh: 服务器通过检查的检查项的数量

PortOpen.description_en:
Indicates whether a port on the server is accessible over the Internet. Valid values:

true
false
PortOpen.description_zh:
该服务器是否有端口对公网开放。取值：

true：服务器有端口对公网开放

false：服务器无端口对公网开放

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region in which the server is deployed

Status.description_en:
The verification status of the risk item after the risk item is fixed. Valid values:

1: complete
2: verifying
Status.description_zh:
基线检查风险项修复完成后，风险项的验证状态。取值：

1：已完成 

2：验证中

Uuid.description_en: The UUID of the server on which the baseline check is performed
Uuid.description_zh: 执行基线检查的服务器的UUID
